name: composite.erd:down
source:
%% A tenant and product id identify one product together.
table products "Tenant catalog" {
  tenant_id  bigint        pk
  id         bigint        pk
  name       varchar(120)
}

table order_items "Items in an order" {
  id          bigint  pk
  tenant_id   bigint
  product_id  bigint
  quantity    int
  foreign(tenant_id, product_id) -> products(tenant_id, id) as fk_product
  index(tenant_id, product_id)
}
